packs.name: Starter Fit-In Pack
notes: UPDATE TIME: October 14, 04:00 (UTC-7)
AVAILABLE PURCHASE PERIOD : Within 14 days of account registration for accounts created after October 14, 04:00 (UTC-7).

CONTENTS: For accounts created after October 14, 04:00 (UTC-7), players who purchase the pack may immediately claim the corresponding rewards based on accumulated login days within 21 days from the date of registration, including Originite Prime, Orundum, Automatic Chip Etcher, and more. Login days accumulated before purchase are also counted.
Day 1: Originite Prime * 1, Automatic Chip Etcher * 1
Day 2: Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 3: Orundum * 600
Day 4: Advanced Material Voucher * 5
Day 5: Orundum * 200
Day 6: Skill Summary - 3 * 10
Automatic Chip Etcher: Use to choose 5 chips of any class.
NOTE:
◆ The newly added [Starter Fit-In Pack] will replace the current [Starter Fit-In Pack]. Players who have already purchased the current [Starter Fit-In Pack] may purchase the new one again.

◆ Players who purchased the current [Starter Fit-In Pack] and still have unclaimed login rewards remaining after October 14, 04:00 (UTC-7) may claim the obtainable but unreceived items from the current [Starter Fit-In Pack] via in-game mail.

packs.name: Newcomer Special Headhunting Pack
notes: ELIGIBLE PLAYERS: Players who registered before October 14, 08:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: Players need to choose one option from the following when purchasing this headhunting pack:
Type-α Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Ascalon, Typhon, Ho'olheyak)
Type-β Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Lemuen, Nymph, Jessica the Liberated)
Type-γ Headhunting Permit (★6 Operators: Goldenglow, Reed the Flame Shadow, Gnosis)

Players will receive the chosen custom headhunting permit upon purchase. The selected permit can be used to perform a [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] that guarantees one random 6-star Operator from its pool.
[Special Ten-roll Headhunting]
- You may select only one of the Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permits and you can only purchase it twice. You cannot change your decision after purchasing.

- The permit is good for [Special Ten-roll Headhunting]. While performing any rolls in [Special Ten-roll Headhunting], rolls that do not give a 6-star Operator will not count towards the 6-star protection mechanism, nor will it affect your accumulated roll count on [Standard Headhunting]. Rates are also not affected by your accumulated roll count on [Standard Headhunting].

- For this Headhunting, players are guaranteed to receive a 6-star Operator when performing a 10-roll. The available pool of 6-star Operators is the same for every player, and depends on the [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] pool chosen.
- [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] includes 5★, 4★, and 3★ Operators from [600 Meters Over the Facts] and all previous [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting] banners.
NOTE:
- Special Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expires at: November 26, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- You may only use this Headhunting Permit once. Upon use, its Headhunting pool will automatically be removed.
- If not used by the expiration date, this Headhunting Permit will be removed from your Depot, so please make sure to use it before it expires.
Aside from a guaranteed 6-star Operator from the selected Headhunting Permit, the pull rates for the [Special Ten-roll Headhunting] are as follows:
★6 Operator: 2%
★5 Operator: 8%
★4 Operator: 50%
★3 Operator: 40%

notices.title: CUMULATIVE SIGN-IN SYSTEM UPDATE
lines: DETAILS: After the update, the rewards in the Cumulative Sign-In system will be updated. Players who reach Level 80 and accumulate 1,500 sign-in days can obtain the Themed Background [Resolve].

notices.title: Monthly card gift
lines: 8 October – 16 November 2026 (UTC−7). Log in daily for 200 Orundum and one 80-Sanity booster; up to 30 claims (6,000 Orundum and 2,400 Sanity).
Rewards reset at 04:00 (UTC−7); missed daily claims do not accumulate. Check the game for booster expiry.

notices.title: To Look Back on Terra
lines: Log in for 3 days between 8 October and 16 November 2026 (UTC−7). Receive a Special Event Transfer Permit, Echoes of Recollection furniture and the Reconstruction home screen UI.

notices.title: Zelgrad Notice Board Wall
lines: CN reference: draw two tickets each day and receive the higher Orundum reward (200, 300, 400, 500, 600 or 800). If your reward is below 400, draw three tickets the next day.
Daily draws reset and cannot be saved. Random Orundum is not included in the fixed reward totals.

notices.title: Kal’tsit’s gift
lines: A letter from Kal’tsit - Esperanta includes a Life Specimen. Use it to receive 30,000 LMD.
JP preview: mail sent October 14 at 16:00 JST; claim before November 13 at 03:59 JST. Global timing and English item name await confirmation.

Recommended Monthly Card.description: October 8 – November 16 (UTC−7): claim 200 Orundum and one Emergency Sanity Booster (80 Sanity) each day, up to 30 days. Missed daily rewards do not accumulate.
